title: Truth: dual geometry and link with report words: pre-registration
status: DRAFT until scripts/freeze_prereg.py --prereg prereg/behaviour_link_prereg.json has written behaviour_link_prereg.lock.json and both files are committed. Edit only before freezing.
relation_to_thesis: Added after the vocabulary-side and paired tests (dictionary_specificity, dual_paired) and an exploratory word-substitution analysis (behaviour_words, no structure) were known. Those concern word-pair concepts. Truth is a property of whole statements and has no unembedding row; this test uses the words a model uses to REPORT truth as its vocabulary-side counterpart. Changes nothing frozen in any earlier pre-registration. Frozen before any output of this test was produced.

questions.dual: Does truth show the published dual geometry: the report-word contrast further toward the head than random word contrasts, and the truth direction further toward the tail than its sign-flip null?
questions.link: Does the truth direction point toward the truth report words more than toward contrasts between random words?

gemma_policy: Every test reported with and without gemma-2-2b; a conclusion is called robust only if it holds both ways.
datasets: The seven truth datasets of the thesis (truth_cities, truth_cities_negated, truth_conjunction, truth_disjunction, truth_counterfact, truth_magnitude, truth_translation), first 512 pairs each, the same files as the thesis. Sycophancy is excluded because the sycophantic answer is 'agree' for some users and 'disagree' for others, so it has no consistent report words.

activation_side.direction: v = mean over pairs of (h_true - h_false) at the last token, per dataset
activation_side.extraction: linear_rep_geometry.behavioral.layerwise_activations, last-token pooling, max_length 256, final norm applied to the last hidden state (the thesis routine)

variants.plain: the statements exactly as in the thesis
variants.prompted: statement + ' This statement is', so that the next token is a truth report

activation_side.null: sign flip: each pair's difference multiplied by an independent random sign, 1,000 draws (the structural null of Appendix A)

vocabulary_side.token_rule: published single-token rule of dictionary_specificity.py; a pair is kept if both words are single tokens mapping to different tokens; a model enters only with at least 4 kept pairs
vocabulary_side.direction: u = mean(gamma(true words)) - mean(gamma(false words)) over the kept pairs
vocabulary_side.null: lexical: 2n words drawn from the single-token words of the 42 word-pair concept files (report words and their tokens excluded), split into two groups of n; 1,000 draws, seed 0. The same draws serve as the null for the link.

statistics.gap_vocab: Gini(u) - mean Gini(lexical null); positive = toward the head
statistics.gap_act: Gini(v) - mean Gini(sign-flip null), averaged over the seven datasets within a model
statistics.link: cos(v, u) - mean cos(v, lexical-null contrast), averaged over the seven datasets within a model
statistics.across_models: one-sample t-test against 0, two-sided, alpha 0.05; TOST with bounds +/-0.082 Gini units for the placement gaps

primary.dual: plain statements, final layer, published language-subset basis
primary.link: prompted statements, final layer, published language-subset basis

decision_rule.dual: 'dual' if the 95% CI of gap_vocab is above 0 AND the 95% CI of gap_act is below 0, in both the all-model and without-gemma versions; 'not dual' if gap_act or gap_vocab is TOST-equivalent to 0 in both versions; otherwise 'inconclusive'
decision_rule.link: 'linked' if the 95% CI of the link is above 0 in both versions; 'reversed' if below 0 in both; otherwise 'no evidence'
decision_rule.validity: at least 6 of 8 models must enter; otherwise 'not testable'

secondary_reported_not_primary: prompted variant for the dual question; plain variant for the link
the link against the sign-flip null
multiplicity: Two primary questions, each decided by its own rule; no other test enters the conclusion.
reporting: The result is reported whatever it is.
